units.summary: NumSeries now returns the number of selected refs instead of the head's live stale-series counter. This changes the block meta stats for stale compaction as well.
units.headline: NumSeries counts selected refs instead of head stale counter
units.reason: Changes the series count reported in block meta and to the compactor.
focus: NumSeries now counts every selected ref, including ones with no data in a given chunk-range slice, so check how the compactor uses this value
